job.job_title: AWS GenAI Engineer @ Noida/Gurgaon / Chennai @ Hybrid mode
job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced AWS GenAI Engineer with strong expertise in Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Amazon Bedrock. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions leveraging AWS cloud services and modern GenAI frameworks to solve business problems at scale.






Preferred candidate profile

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop GenAI applications using Amazon Bedrock, foundation models, and AWS AI services.
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines for enterprise knowledge systems.
Integrate vector databases such as OpenSearch, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Develop intelligent chatbots, virtual assistants, document Q&A, and AI-powered search solutions.
Implement prompt engineering strategies and fine-tuning approaches to improve model performance.
Create scalable APIs and microservices using Python and AWS serverless technologies.
Work with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases, and orchestration frameworks.
Design data ingestion, embedding generation, indexing, and retrieval workflows.
Ensure security, governance, and responsible AI practices across solutions.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and data engineering teams.
Monitor model performance, optimize latency, and manage cloud infrastructure costs.

Required Skills

AWS Services

Amazon Bedrock
AWS Lambda
API Gateway
S3
IAM
ECS/EKS
Step Functions
CloudWatch
OpenSearch
DynamoDB
Secrets Manager

Generative AI

Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
RAG Architecture
Foundation Models (Claude, Llama, Titan, etc.)
Embeddings and Vector Search
Fine-Tuning / Model Customization
AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems

Programming & Frameworks

Python (Mandatory)
LangChain
LlamaIndex
FastAPI / Flask
REST APIs
Git, CI/CD

Databases

Vector Databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, ChromaDB, FAISS)
SQL / NoSQL Databases

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Bedrock Agents.
Experience deploying LLM applications in production environments.
Knowledge of MLOps, Model Monitoring, and AI Governance.
AWS Certification (AWS Solutions Architect, AWS AI Practitioner, or AWS Machine Learning Specialty) is preferred.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or CloudFormation is an added advantage.

Nice to Have

Experience with multimodal AI solutions.
Exposure to OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Meta Llama models.
Knowledge of data pipelines and ETL frameworks.
Understanding of NLP, embeddings, and semantic search.

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or related field.

Keywords

AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Generative AI, GenAI, RAG, LLM, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Database, Pinecone, OpenSearch, Claude, Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Agents, Python, AI Engineer, Prompt Engineering, Machine Learning, NLP.
